name: Yagami Rin
source: A third-year student at Yaesaka, member of the archery club, and a miko at Yagami Shrine. She is short and does not look like an upperclassman at all. She feels an impurity in the school and her presence gets in the way of Hatsune's deception of the students.
translation: A third-year student at Yaesaka, member of the archery club, and a miko at Yagami Shrine. She is short and does not look like an upperclassman at all. She feels an impurity in the school and her presence gets in the way of Hatsune's deception of the students.
